read.thesis: Q3 adjusted EPS $2.26 (+33%) and FY26 guidance raised again, but about $0.25 of EPS and $0.4bn of profit came from one-off IEEPA recovery; underlying supply-side signals are capacity-light and not discussed.

capex.quote: Capital expenditures were $0.7 billion, resulting in free cash flow* of $2.1 billion.

triggers.label: Backlog record $340bn
triggers.quote: resulting in a record backlog of $340 billion

triggers.label: Inventory up, op cash flow down 38%
triggers.quote: Operating cash flow of $2.9 billion, including approximately $0.3 billion from IEEPA recovery

guidance.quote: Adjusted sales* of $97.0 - $97.5 billion, up from $95.0 - $96.0 billion
Organic sales growth* of 10 to 11 percent, up from 8 to 9 percent
Free cash flow* of $9.0 - $9.2 billion, up from $8.50 - $8.75 billion

red_flags.label: One-off IEEPA recovery flatters Q3 profit
red_flags.quote: Adjusted EPS* of $2.26, up $0.56, or 33 percent, versus prior year, including $0.25 from IEEPA cost recovery

red_flags.label: Customer bankruptcy charge at P&W
red_flags.quote: Reported operating profit included a charge of $363 million related to a customer bankruptcy.
